body: I've opened https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14076 with some suggestions for an acceptance test and an error message wording improvement. A little bit vibey but shows what I mean. I'll leave it to you to decide what you want to do with this PR. Feel free to push to the branch, or take the commits to yours, or not.

## Pull request overview

This PR improves the `gh repo sync` user experience when the target branch is checked out in a different Git worktree by detecting that state up front and returning a curated, actionable error message.
